name: Master Yi
title: The Wuju Bladesman

passive.name: Double Strike

description.normalized: Every 4th consecutive attack strikes twice for 78 (150% AD) physical damage.

passive.rawParsedText: Every 4th consecutive attack strikes twice for 78 (150% AD) physical damage.

q.name: Alpha Strike

description.normalized: Becomes untargetable and strikes up to 4 enemies for20 / 60 / 100 / 140 (+60% AD) physical damage. If there are no other targets Master Yi will strike a previous target for 25% damage. Attacks reduce the cooldown of Alpha Strike by 1 seconds. Deals 105 / 135 / 165 / 195 bonus damage to monsters and minions. Can critically strike, dealing 60% bonus damage.

w.name: Meditate

description.normalized: Channels for up to 4 seconds, gaining 55% / 60% / 65% / 70% damage reduction and healing for 40 / 60 / 80 / 100 (+25% AP) each second. Damage reduction increases to 90% during the first 0.5 seconds. Damage reduction effect during the first 0.5 seconds of channeling will continue after the channeling is interrupted. Heal is increased the lower Master Yi's Health is, up to 100%.

e.name: Wuju Style
